prompt: A few small rectangular sheets of paper floating flat on the open sea, spread in a loose overlapping fan, seen from slightly above in gentle perspective. Each sheet has wide margins and an empty inner picture frame drawn as a thin ruled rectangle with nothing inside it, like blank mounted prints. Their corners curl slightly, their edges are lapped by wave lines, and small ripples spread around them. One sheet has a thicker soft violet #7C5CD6 border and a tiny violet #7C5CD6 check mark in its corner. All drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading, in the same engraved line as the sea. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density highest in the deep water at the top and thinning steadily downwards, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the top to lighter cerulean at the bottom, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots in the upper water, a delicate compass rose with fine tick marks in the top left corner, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. The lower third is calm open water in a lighter cerulean tint, with only sparse, thin, pale wave lines and nothing floating in it. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no horizon, no sky, no clouds, full-bleed edge to edge, the sea covering the whole image, no border, no frame, the fan of sheets small, kept within the upper two thirds and towards the right. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of soft violet #7C5CD6 on that one sheet only.
